description: Job board: prepare (unsigned) taking an open REPORT job. First call job_ticket for the job (it returns the accept voucher and its deadline), then pass them here as `voucher` and `voucherDeadline`. The call locks a bond (usually 20% of the reward, shown in the reply) in the job's token: send the approval first, the exact amount. You get the bond back with the reward when the poster approves. If you do not deliver before the job's deadline you lose the bond. Only jobs paid in the game token are handled here. Returns an unsigned request; nothing is sent.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_board_accept
